reason: I'd try the free 5 dishes, big buttons are nice when my hands are dirty. But I already ask my free AI app for recipes, and I cook the simple dishes I know, so I don't see why I should pay 99 baht now for dishes I can ask about for free.
objection: Paying by PromptPay ahead of time to a new app I've never heard of, for dishes that don't exist yet. 99 baht is groceries for two meals for my family, and the free AI already answers my questions.
would_change_my_mind: If I use the free 5 dishes for a few weeks and the chef really fixes my mistakes better than my free AI, then I'd pay once the 12 dishes are actually there, not as a pre-order.
